title: Darklight Conflict
overview:
Will the Dark Swallow the Light?

Abducted from your fighter by an alien race, you're enlisted in the ultimate battle.

The Reptons and Ovons are locked in a deadly duel for supremacy, and you're the Repton's secret weapon. You've been genetically altered, making you one with your Repton craft.

Now you must wage war against the Ovons while trying to find a way home. When an Earth warrior takes on Heaven's best, the outcome can only be...Hellish.

Features
- Advanced lighting effects - watch enemies explode in a brilliant flash
- Real-time lens flare and light-sourcing
- Over 50 single player missions
- Use diverse combat tactics to complete missions: dogfighting, bombing runs turret defense, and strategic reconnaissance and rescue operations
- Pilot various ships including attack fighters, gunships and bombers
- Shatter your enemy with 14 different weapons
